responsibility: Implements the x86 common target option registry used to describe valid -march and -mtune selections and their associated ISA/processor implications outside the core backend. The file defines the large processor alias table and ISA implication macros that encode x86 CPU families, feature availability, and default tuning classes, and exposes TARGET_GET_VALID_OPTION_VALUES so GCC can enumerate accepted architecture/tuning names (including native when supported). It is the common metadata layer for x86 CPU/ISA option names, distinct from the separate runtime CPU-detection headers and the main i386 backend’s code-generation logic.
